Management is expanding the SKU portfolio to 50-55, with ramp- up benefits expected over the next couple of quarters.

Glassware capacity utilisation remained at ~60%, with revenue growth supported by improved product mix and 8– 10% price hikes; however, elevated gas prices, which account for ~30% of segment costs, offset the benefits, resulting in EBITDA breakeven.
Opalware utilisation stood at ~80%, with marginal YoY growth, and existing capacity is expected to be exhausted by next year.
